text: 🍿 Avatar 4 finally gets a date, and Cameron wants it cheaper James Cameron is 72 and has told Empire's podcast he wants films four and five made faster and for less money than 'The Way of Water' and 'Fire and Ash'. /Film reports that Disney's calendar now lists 'Avatar 4' for December 21, 2029, and 'Avatar 5' for December 19, 2031. Parts of the fourth film were shot alongside 'Fire and Ash' so the young cast, Jack Champion and Trinity Bliss among them, still pass as kids. Cameron has also promised a six-year time jump. A leaner production is the right instinct for a saga whose budgets became its own plot.
